A fact gives the Ceramic Pro 9H hatchback price of ₹18,000 with GST included, citing the prices page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004, with reviewDate 2027-02-21 (three months after today). The Graphene Max sedan price of ₹32,000, in its own fact or in the same one, also cites the prices page with reviewDate 2027-02-21. Every fact that states a price has reviewDate 2027-02-21. The facts on the ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes and on the Baner studio cite the home page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001; every fact that states no price has reviewDate 2027-11-21. A fact that states no price but is taken from the prices page may cite that page.
